grid.note: 32x12 squares (384 total), 40x40px, burned into every frame. Columns 1-32 left->right, rows A-L top->bottom. Spot The Ball (Balamurugan et al., arXiv:2511.00261) uses a 6x10 (60-cell) alphanumeric grid burned onto the image; this is the same convention at much finer, square resolution.

questions.locate_now: The ball has been made invisible. This clip shows 4s of play. A 32x12 grid is overlaid on the video (columns 1-32 left to right, rows A-L top to bottom). Based on player positions, body orientation, and motion, which grid cell is the ball in RIGHT NOW, at the final frame of the clip? Answer with a cell like 'F14'.
questions.predict_next: Now predict one second further: which grid cell will the ball be in at 1 second after this clip ends? Answer in the same format.
